title: An item due today is listed as overdue
goal: People stop being told that work due today is late.

acceptance_criteria.text: An item is overdue when it is not done and its due date is before today (UTC). An item due today is not overdue (reported: GET /todos?overdue=true lists it).
Nothing the API answers lists or counts an item due today as overdue.
A test fails without the fix: it covers the day an item is due and the day after.

context.notes: Find the cause. Keep node:http only; no dependencies.
